clips.title: The story
paras: Hollee sends Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore to Darnassus. She stays behind to watch the wandering prospector, and Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker takes a keen interest in the find.

Prospector Remtravel has unearthed a curious fossil along Darkshore's coast. He cares more about digging deeper than following protocol. Archaeologist Hollee stays behind to watch over him among the shore's dangerous beasts and hostile cultists. She asks you, an Alliance traveler, to carry the specimen to Darnassus, where the dwarven guild keeps a scholarly delegation.

Dwarves from Ironforge have crossed the Great Sea under the Explorers' League banner, searching Kalimdor's soil for ancient relics and lost history. In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker marvels at Remtravel's knack for finding ancient treasures. Night elves see their forests as living sanctuaries, while the League sees ancient lands as ground to study and decipher.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So the prospector wants to send the mysterious fossil to the Explorers' League in Darnassus? I don't feel right leaving Darkshore without him.
Here, friend, deliver the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for you, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my! Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
